description: This file defines the Customer model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to add, update, delete, and retrieve customer data, manage customer-related records such as addresses, login attempts, authorizations, tokens, and histories, and contains logic specific to customer operations within the platform.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class managing customer data and operations such as creation, update, deletion, and retrieval, as well as handling related records like addresses, login logs, authorizations, tokens, and histories.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database with provided data, handles customer group logic, and manages approval workflows.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details in the database identified by customer ID.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer and all related records (activities, addresses, affiliate info, approvals, rewards, transactions, wishlists, histories, IPs, authorizations) from the database.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details as an associative array by customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by email address.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers with a specific email.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a customer.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP records associated with a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the number of IP records for a customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Logs a login event with customer's IP and country details.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt for a customer email and IP.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Removes login attempt records for a specific email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt details for an email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Adds an authorization record for a customer with token, IP, and user-agent data.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attempts or count in an authorization record.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes authorization records, optionally by ID.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Deletes an authorization record based on customer ID and token.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization record by customer ID and token, including total attempts.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the total count in authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a new token record for a customer, replacing existing tokens of the same type.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Removes a token record identified by its code.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a token record and associated customer info by token code, invalidating tokens older than 10 minutes.
